section.34: The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

34.name_native: The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

hadiths.text: Al-Bara' said:We found on the Day of Khaibar domestic asses, and the announcer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned over
